commonCore: Hear a simple story and note key points in simple words or sentences.
Preserve the relationships among a character's goal, obstacle, action, event order and outcome.
Select details to fit the listening task and do not present inference as explicitly stated fact.
integratedDifferences: The Nani-labelled school plan directly lists 5-Ⅳ-8 and a short-story unit; the Hanlin-labelled plan offers grade/version context but no target-specific teaching sequence; Kang Hsuan unit materials were not obtained. These evidence types are not equivalent to three publisher chapter readings.
originalTeaching: Six original sections teach task-directed listening, event-path notes, transitions/causality, fact-versus-inference, targeted replay, and peer retell as a sufficiency check.
Four original listening scripts and answer choices test plot sequence, cause, outcome, and avoiding invented motives.
The local web SpeechSynthesis path has collapsed transcript disclosure and explicit non-audio fallback.
